component.name: OctoShield
component.summary: Review and configure Ubuntu laptop protections

description.p: OctoShield brings established Ubuntu security tools into a native GNOME interface, with a terminal interface available for administrators.

Review firewall protection, USB authorization, desktop locking, security updates, application confinement, and security-event monitoring. You choose each change, and privileged operations require administrator authentication.
Installation alone does not enable hardening. OctoShield records system changes and keeps recovery information so you can make informed adjustments.
